_note: Search space of scripts/sensitivity_analysis.py for StuppFKPPSolver: one entry per swept parameter ({"min", "max", "scale"}: a factor sampled on the unit cube and transformed to the range, "log" as 10 ** (log10 min + u (log10 max - log10 min)), "linear" as min + u (max - min)) or per fixed override (a plain JSON value written into every run config). Everything not listed comes from the base config given on the command line. Keys starting with '_' are comments.
_scales: Rate and scale parameters whose range spans a decade or more are sampled log-uniformly (rho, white_matter_diffusivity, diffusivity_ratio, chemo_kill_rate, chemo_decay_rate, rt_alpha, gaussian_seed_mass, gaussian_seed_scale: the response is expected to depend on their order of magnitude, and a uniform draw would spend most samples in the top decade). Additive or narrow parameters are sampled uniformly (resection_time, rt_alpha_beta_ratio, the seed position).
_seed: The three gaussian_seed_{x,y,z}_fraction entries must be linear factors within [0, 1]; the script reinterprets their sampled value per axis as a coordinate in the bounding box of the seedable cavity voxels (the base config's resection_cavity label with wm + gm > 0), fraction = lo + u (hi - lo) in the (v + 0.5) / n convention, and projects the point onto the nearest seedable voxel (Euclidean, voxel units).
_units: rho 1/day; white_matter_diffusivity mm^2/day; diffusivity_ratio dimensionless (white-to-gray-matter diffusivity ratio); resection_time days after the seed; chemo_kill_rate 1/day per mg/m^2; chemo_decay_rate 1/day; rt_alpha 1/Gy; rt_alpha_beta_ratio Gy (the linear-quadratic alpha/beta ratio, rt_beta = rt_alpha / rt_alpha_beta_ratio); gaussian_seed_mass and gaussian_seed_scale dimensionless seed parameters.
_sources: rho, white_matter_diffusivity and diffusivity_ratio: min/max of the estimates over the TUM-GBM cohort in scripts/parameter_range.txt (diffusivity_ratio as 10 ** the log10 range). rt_alpha_beta_ratio 4-12 Gy: clinical GBM estimates (Pedicini et al. 2014, Strahlenther Onkol 190:925: alpha/beta = 8 Gy, 95 % CI 5.0-10.8 Gy). resection_time, chemo_kill_rate, chemo_decay_rate, rt_alpha, gaussian_seed_mass and gaussian_seed_scale: placeholder ranges carried over from scripts/run_stupp_sweep.py (rt_alpha narrowed to 0.02-0.2), awaiting review.
